versions.changelog:
- Updated API endpoint domain in all cURL examples from api.renderio.dev to renderio.dev
- No functional changes to code samples or documentation
- File content and workflows remain unchanged

RenderIO FFmpeg API Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the RenderIO FFmpeg-as-a-Service API skill.
- Provides instructions for authenticating, submitting FFmpeg commands, polling status, and retrieving processed media via the RenderIO API.
- Includes clear rules for command formatting and key naming conventions.
- Offers ready-to-use code samples in TypeScript and Python.
- Features a library of common FFmpeg command recipes for video, audio, and image processing use cases.
